author: কুমুদ ঘোষ
description: Kareng Ghar means royal palace and the earliest constructions were commissioned by Sukhrungphaa in 1698 AD. After the destruction of the old palace it was rebuilt around 1752 as the present seven-storied structure by Suremphaa (1751–1769).
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
